cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Brighter Side
cards.instruction: Meet every setback with even greater optimism.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The car won't start. Excellent: we can practise the walking route. Short strides, please; you'll last longer.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's pouring, and my shoe leaks.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Better still: proper wet-weather practice. Keep to the crown of the pavement; that's where the water drains off.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The pavement's flooded. We have to turn back.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful, return navigation as well. You lead us back to the car; I'll correct your route. Please don't skip the puddle exercise.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 strides, A3 drainage and A5 supervised navigation make the optimist an exacting instructor rather than simply a cheerful walker.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 wet conditions cause A3 wet-weather practice; B4 retreat causes A5 return-navigation practice on the same route.

relationship.evidence: B2 discomfort and B4 impassable pavement give B practical reasons to abandon the outing; A uses both as further training.

heightening.evidence: A5 expands the learning claim to returning, turning B4 abandonment into an additional achievement.

specificity.evidence: A1 failed car and B4 blocked pavement establish why they leave and why they must return.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 assigns B the lead and A correction, then preserves the wet-weather task instead of explaining the theme.

coach2.stated: A1 car remains the origin; B2 rain and leak; B4 flooding stops outward travel; A5 returns toward the car.
coach2.inferred: A is increasingly optimistic about the instructional value despite never reaching the original destination.
coach2.missing: The exact destination is not needed to understand the abandoned trip and return.
coach2.firstDefect: No material comprehension defect identified after the practical return instruction.
